caseName: United States v. 119 Cartons Containing 30,000 Obscene Magazines
caseNameFull: United States v. 119 Cartons Containing 30,000 Obscene Magazines (Scan Imports, claimant)

opinions.text:
Appeal from D. C. C. D. Cal. Judgment vacated and case remanded for reconsideration in light of this Court’s decision in United States v. Thirty-Seven (87) Photographs (Luros, Claimant), ante, p. 363.

Mr. Justice Douglas dissents from this action of the Court.
